regulation_or_circular: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023
student_right: publication by the institution of any information in the prospectus, which is false or misleading, and not based on facts;

regulation_or_circular: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023
student_right: withholding of, or refusal to return, any document in the form of certificates of degree, diploma or any other award or other document deposited by a student for the purpose of seeking admission in such institution, with a view to induce or compel such student to pay any fee or fees in respect of any course or program of study which such student does not intend to pursue;

regulation_or_circular: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023
student_right: demand of money in excess of that specified to be charged in the declared admission policy of the institution;

rule_title: Delay or Denial of Fee Refund
regulation_or_circular: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023
student_right: delay in, or denial of, the refund of fees due to a student who withdraws admission within the time mentioned in the prospectus, subject to guidelines, if any, issued by the Commission, from time to time;

regulation_or_circular: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023
student_right: A complaint from an aggrieved student relating to the institution shall be addressed to the Chairperson, Students’ Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC).

regulation_or_circular: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023
student_right: The SGRC shall send its report with recommendations, if any, to the competent authority of the institution concerned and a copy thereof to the aggrieved student, pr eferably within a period of 15 working days from the date of receipt of the complaint.

regulation_or_circular: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023
student_right: Any student aggrieved by the decision of the Students’ Grievance Redressal Committee may prefer an appeal to the Ombudsperson, within a period of fifteen days from the date of receipt of such decision.

regulation_or_circular: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023
student_right: The Ombudsperson shall make all efforts to resolve the grievances within a period of 30 days of receiving the appeal from the aggrieved student
